claims.claim: Estimated 1RM commonly uses the Epley and Brzycki formulas; the Epley formula is weight * (1 + reps/30). Epley and Brzycki return identical results for 10 repetitions.

claims.claim: RIR (reps in reserve) is how many more reps could be completed before technical failure; RIR 2 = 2 reps left, RIR 0 = technical failure. RPE and RIR are used together to autoregulate training load. The widely used RIR-based RPE scale runs RPE 6 (about 4+ RIR) to RPE 10 (0 RIR).
claims.raw_snippet: An RIR of 2 means the client could have done 2 more reps. An RIR of 0 means they were at technical failure.
